Apple cider vinegar (ACV) is a popular folk remedy for hangovers, though clinical evidence proving it cures hangovers is limited . Proponents suggest it may help stabilize blood sugar or reduce morning fluid retention, while others report feeling better after drinking it diluted.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF14P8F0-f9LuFn1R3yXFYhkHYpmDWyzi2S-3Mq1fitgZ9dSjBS8MMFKYR53IggkM0CwLenxdBrh6KzJ8DiHcWB_jkLzuCixqancP2fmHBkfXD9Rj7xCNyW1Iuiemnkz_i_XK6mgrrmSwHCf8173jKfjHWTBjn7FZspDU_JyLFRJjk24Wp)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF1x9H4QAAFO3fKvSxj3Jg7pmPytEW5R7yOwOmSJaOVEaMmQLJlD0mRW9QHHpa750sv-t_QkeOloo29avsbhrmG4okZ9s8neYR8DyGuUjW9by3tHtseh-bKJks90RpaXYzMHYURl8vf0Pxi9OE5K5dDOAmkTGYWHYhAhkr1-bNNY4KdTPBt5wa6yvUIOJKpnWIRPX-zZguIqyGVA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF13zVpcDwnlH4hrQKtnlIYYYsIk18XGftxenPCpJ4L3KMu8UwmQ42p0wqUodU_PHZzWnpBc-mThqY_6MCiHXuaSn6wnwx3QlEGPWOK4Yo8L5Fzfs8w-ttBHDYELOM89N12H2jJ1Z7MpsOoo4VFTu0MhWbUioFZI4wxqn8aQNrscYIUwVBmWrYs7qvVOE)

### How People Use It

- **Dilute first:** Mix 1 to 2 tablespoons (or up to 1–2 ounces in some recipes) into a full glass of water. Never drink it straight, as the acid can irritate your throat and stomach or erode tooth enamel.
- **Optional mix-ins:** Some people add honey, ginger, or green tea to improve taste and target nausea or sluggishness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF14P8F0-f9LuFn1R3yXFYhkHYpmDWyzi2S-3Mq1fitgZ9dSjBS8MMFKYR53IggkM0CwLenxdBrh6KzJ8DiHcWB_jkLzuCixqancP2fmHBkfXD9Rj7xCNyW1Iuiemnkz_i_XK6mgrrmSwHCf8173jKfjHWTBjn7FZspDU_JyLFRJjk24Wp)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF15CjxKuJDfcvKTmoPoXE-9ptvJIfticYC3e5NegxXCRewFf0f6OY4gpvGbogH7bHja__axXFKRrlgno8_UFAY-ulY_GvLL31bz5PHZ6HgN1t6AlhkrfI_Zrkea2WPOZBY46JtitHfwv-M422yY5lPzg59YABCkDPpjR9VjrcWJK8DObVo7g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF13zVpcDwnlH4hrQKtnlIYYYsIk18XGftxenPCpJ4L3KMu8UwmQ42p0wqUodU_PHZzWnpBc-mThqY_6MCiHXuaSn6wnwx3QlEGPWOK4Yo8L5Fzfs8w-ttBHDYELOM89N12H2jJ1Z7MpsOoo4VFTu0MhWbUioFZI4wxqn8aQNrscYIUwVBmWrYs7qvVOE)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXb4gHuGuPVN6-5vwrEZV0xpi-i34njWDxh228TdaEm_6dsVr1iGNKNPmwUoOv6-Noyxy5KMOduT01J38lPQouZq-65oahNFYxVuvIOMmefSrzSKSmfELc6y0h3q3r5JbGfQ)

### Risks and Proven Alternatives

- **Stomach irritation:** Alcohol already irritates the stomach lining, and acidic drinks like vinegar can worsen nausea, reflux, or stomach pain—especially on an empty stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXzQiUX03Vn2NGpb3fOtSoTt61ociiuG6eJicoXywbbXlW4N0uYIfHxwnba-fdj54Wic5FOAPVvmXcAIsdx3Nycdy0FMAFVQCt8rWBM-ZG7BLmMEbS6ZkeJ6SXLOItzD0f-DpAHA7oLg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF1x9H4QAAFO3fKvSxj3Jg7pmPytEW5R7yOwOmSJaOVEaMmQLJlD0mRW9QHHpa750sv-t_QkeOloo29avsbhrmG4okZ9s8neYR8DyGuUjW9by3tHtseh-bKJks90RpaXYzMHYURl8vf0Pxi9OE5K5dDOAmkTGYWHYhAhkr1-bNNY4KdTPBt5wa6yvUIOJKpnWIRPX-zZguIqyGVA)
- **Proven hangover relief:** Rehydrating with water or electrolyte drinks is more reliably helpful. There is a consensus on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEBxCJF1y14y8_BuAIMNMVvblFJnjr0LAAmRFc7PEZba1y02XtgfoVQNh6NPMCWZO11UKlH7NErRC_pwp9TcUudh7fs4EbY4o90zsCurCB7g2zqAHxXaM8LHySnihkmRws69H92zyCN6WnkOiH5cSjoH-gLL2dr5h3NjnMKILJeNxANAdUyPZ74wh4FBoFBPy3p7WZomQWfg6by9X4) that electrolyte drinks like Pedialyte or Gatorade help address dehydration and restore salt and carb balance. Bland carbs, eggs, and rest also help manage symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF14P8F0-f9LuFn1R3yXFYhkHYpmDWyzi2S-3Mq1fitgZ9dSjBS8MMFKYR53IggkM0CwLenxdBrh6KzJ8DiHcWB_jkLzuCixqancP2fmHBkfXD9Rj7xCNyW1Iuiemnkz_i_XK6mgrrmSwHCf8173jKfjHWTBjn7FZspDU_JyLFRJjk24Wp)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF1x9H4QAAFO3fKvSxj3Jg7pmPytEW5R7yOwOmSJaOVEaMmQLJlD0mRW9QHHpa750sv-t_QkeOloo29avsbhrmG4okZ9s8neYR8DyGuUjW9by3tHtseh-bKJks90RpaXYzMHYURl8vf0Pxi9OE5K5dDOAmkTGYWHYhAhkr1-bNNY4KdTPBt5wa6yvUIOJKpnWIRPX-zZguIqyGVA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEBxCJF1y14y8_BuAIMNMVvblFJnjr0LAAmRFc7PEZba1y02XtgfoVQNh6NPMCWZO11UKlH7NErRC_pwp9TcUudh7fs4EbY4o90zsCurCB7g2zqAHxXaM8LHySnihkmRws69H92zyCN6WnkOiH5cSjoH-gLL2dr5h3NjnMKILJeNxANAdUyPZ74wh4FBoFBPy3p7WZomQWfg6by9X4)

If you're dealing with a hangover right now, let me know your **main symptoms** (like nausea, headache, or dehydration) and **whether you've eaten yet** so I can suggest safer, targeted relief.
